items.title: Semiconductor correction broadening
items.detail: TSMC beat (+77% y/y profit) yet ADRs fell ~5% pre-market on capex-vs-margin worry; memory (SK Hynix, SanDisk) down ~7%; Nasdaq -1.47% Jul 16. AI-hardware carries the index's earnings-revision fuel — a topping tape there pressures the whole market.

items.title: US-Gulf tension / oil
items.detail: Rising Gulf/Iran tension kept Brent ~$84.63 and pressured stocks early. An energy-price shock would threaten the disinflation story into the Jul 28-29 FOMC.

items.title: Earnings-reaction risk
items.detail: Netflix fell ~10% pre-market Jul 17 on its print; even beats (TSMC, GS) sold off. Guidance bars are high — SLB reports today.

items.title: Narrow leadership / megacap concentration
items.detail: Alphabet -4.6% and the chip basket led lower while defensives (NKE, IBM) held. Breadth is selective; the index leans on a few names.

items.title: Two-sided Fed into Jul 28-29
items.detail: June PPI -0.3% m/m says disinflation, yet some desks still flag hike risk. 10Y ~4.55%, curve positive. A hawkish surprise hits long-duration software hardest.

items.title: VIX low vs headline load
items.detail: VIX 16.31 with a naval-tension backdrop and a heavy earnings week leaves the tape lightly hedged against gap risk.

items.title: Story-name froth
items.detail: Speculative AI-power/space/SMR names (SMR, TE, APLD, OPEN, HTZ) remain thin-fundamental and prone to sharp drawdowns if risk appetite fades.
